# TableSlate

TableSlate is a native, offline-first iPhone and iPad score-keeping companion for tabletop games.

Key pages:
- https://tableslate.malaber.de/ — product overview
- https://tableslate.malaber.de/capabilities/ — scoring, persistence, definition engine, accessibility
- https://tableslate.malaber.de/support/ — support and import troubleshooting
- https://tableslate.malaber.de/privacy/ — privacy policy

Privacy summary: no account, analytics, tracking, advertising, backend, or uploaded game history.
